description.value:
Frequency once per day

Duration until triggered or 1 hour

Name a target; profit the next time it fails against you.

Name one creature you can currently perceive. The next time that creature fails a check or saving throw against you before the duration ends, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next check or saving throw against it. The Ledger doesn't do favors, only terms.

cinderfall.incomplete: Genuine engine limit, not a missing companion Effect: the trigger is "the next time that creature fails a check or save against you, sometime in the next hour" -- an outcome watched across time on someone ELSE's future rolls, then retroactively granting a new buff. Checked real pf2e's own precedent for this exact trigger shape -- pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/actions/background/opportunistic-accusation.json and pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/actions/archetype/soulforger/makes-me-stronger.json, both "react to an opponent's roll result" abilities -- and both ship with rules: [] and no selfEffect in the official compendium. No combination of TokenMark/FlatModifier/Aura/ChoiceSet watches a future roll's degree of success and grants something afterward; this needs manual GM/player tracking, the same as real pf2e's own content of this shape.
